name: @phonaria/lab-contract
description: Shared browser-level Lab contract. Runs against a deployed base URL through target-specific configuration.

scripts.e2e:start-slice: playwright test e2e/charts.spec.ts && playwright test e2e/routes.spec.ts e2e/metadata.spec.ts e2e/security.spec.ts e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --grep "serves Credits|serves the consonant chart|serves the vowel chart|temporarily redirects|returns a real not-found page|metadata for /credits|metadata for /ipa-chart|robots.txt crawlable|sends a CSP|axe violations on Credits|axe violations on the not-found|axe violations on the consonant|axe violations on the vowel"
